SOAS University of London, Sochon Foundation Scholarship 2022 is an initiative by Sochon Foundation for students who are undertaking full-time postgraduate programmes in Korean Studies. The aim of this scholarship is to support the study of meritorious students. The selected students will receive up to £9,000 for fee purposes.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Have an offer of admission to the degree programme by the scholarship application deadline
Meet the English language condition of their offer of admission to study at SOAS as soon as possible.
The selected candidates will receive benefits in the following ways -
An explanation of the grading system for any degrees obtained outside of the UK

The candidates will be assessed on a combination of financial need and academic merit by a selection panel consisting of three academic members from the Centre of Korean Studies.
The successful candidates will be notified by the end of July.
Priority will be given to overseas applicants.
Any awards held will be taken into consideration on assessment of financial need.

New applicants only (new admissions, starting in September 2022/23) must also submit a complete online application to the desired programme as soon as possible and then submit an application for the scholarship.
Applicants applying for scholarships must also submit an application for admission well in advance in order to be considered.

Please note that complete applications for admission can take up to 4 weeks to be considered by the Department, although this duration can vary depending on the time of year. The applicants should be prepared to wait up to 6 weeks in busy periods.
The applicants will need to have a firm offer for the programme by the time the Scholarship panel meet.
